title: Pip's Lost Lanterns
summary: A storm blew Pip's three moon lanterns all over the village. Pip, who works at the inn, would be grateful to have them back.

steps.task: Find Pip's moon lanterns around the village.
Bring the lanterns back to Pip at the inn.

lines: LOST: three little moon lanterns, blown away in Tuesday's storm. They glow pale blue and hum softly. A reward for their return! - Pip, at the inn
You fold the notice into your pocket.
The storm took all three of my moon lanterns! I've pinned a notice on the board in the square, in case anyone can help.
Any luck? They're small and glow pale blue. The wind could have carried them anywhere in the village.
Is that... You found them! All three!
Listen, they're humming again. Oh, thank you!
Please, take this ribbon. It's spun from moth wings, and it glows a little at night.
My lanterns shine in the inn's window every night now, thanks to you.
